evals.name: named-prd-skips-menu
evals.prompt: ok so i want to build a habit tracker app called Streakly. idea: people drop habits after a week because there's no accountability, so you pair up with a buddy and both see each other's streaks; if one misses a day the other gets nudged to check in. flowchart: sign up -> pick habits -> invite buddy via link -> daily check-in -> streak updates -> missed day? -> buddy notified -> weekly recap email. stack: Next.js, Supabase (auth + postgres), Resend for email, maybe Vercel cron. make me a PRD
evals.expected_output: Skips the menu, loads prd-builder/SKILL.md, and writes a full PRD in that builder's structure with no bracket placeholders.
assertions: PRD contains Problem Alignment, Solution Summary, Scope & Capabilities, and Delivery/Risks sections

evals.name: named-claude-md-skips-menu-and-followup
evals.prompt:
make me a CLAUDE.md from my README:

# QuickNote
### A Chrome extension that saves highlighted text to local notes instantly

## Overview
QuickNote lets you highlight text on any page and save it to a local notes panel. No account, no server.

## Tech Stack
| Layer | Technology |
|---|---|
| Platform | Chrome Extension Manifest V3 |
| UI | Vanilla JS + CSS |
| Storage | chrome.storage.local |

## Folder Structure
```
quicknote/
  manifest.json
  background.js
  content.js
  popup/
    popup.html
    popup.js
    popup.css
```

## Security Notes
- Never send note content to any remote server.
- Never request the <all_urls> host permission beyond activeTab.
evals.expected_output: Skips the menu and the agent-rules follow-up, loads agent_project_rules_builder/SKILL.md, and writes a CLAUDE.md derived only from the README, with no leftover {PLACEHOLDER} tokens.
assertions: Includes the README's never-rules (no remote send, activeTab only)
